data.one_liner: Detects soft-keyboard open and close status in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Detects whether the software keyboard is open or closed and provides a callback when its visibility changes. It wraps a child widget to expose keyboard status updates.
use_when: You need to run callbacks when the software keyboard opens or closes
You want to react to keyboard visibility changes within a specific widget subtree
avoid_when: You need complex form management or advanced layout resizing handled automatically
You require granular height measurements of the software keyboard rather than just a boolean state
strengths: Provides a straightforward boolean callback for keyboard visibility
weaknesses: Provides only basic open and close status without exact keyboard height metrics
Lacks extensive documentation or advanced configuration options
